$comment: Emitted by `pnpm analyse:drift` after crawl 2. Committed in PENDING form before crawl 2 runs, because the shape itself is pre-registered: the fields below are the ones the analysis is allowed to fill, and a field that is not here cannot be added later without an additive appendix commit. See corpus/PREDICTIONS.md and CRAWL_DATES.md.
intervalBasis: pre-registered from CRAWL_DATES.md (2026-09-15 -> 2026-10-20). Overwritten with the measured day count between crawl1StartedAt and crawl2StartedAt when status becomes "complete".
nBasis: servers captured in BOTH crawls. null until crawl 2 runs; never inferred from crawl 1 alone.
scheduledForBasis: copied from CRAWL_DATES.md, which is the authority. Present here so the console reads one machine-readable file instead of parsing markdown; `pnpm analyse:drift` re-asserts them against CRAWL_DATES.md.

prediction.metric: semantic-intent drift, share of servers captured in both crawls with >= 1 semantic-intent change

countedSeparately.$comment: CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 9: cosmetic and schema-additive changes are counted and published separately and NEVER enter a headline number.
